OR-E5.Description:
Apply technical SEO, AI-assisted-search-friendly content, structured data, and the remaining informational/legal pages — improving clarity and usefulness without promising ranking outcomes.

SCOPE:
- Metadata builders: unique titles/descriptions, canonical URLs, Open Graph
- XML sitemap and robots.txt
- Breadcrumbs with BreadcrumbList JSON-LD
- JSON-LD for Product, Offer (verified only), WebSite, Organization
- About, contact, privacy, terms, and cookie pages
- Original FAQs and buying guides
- Image and rendering performance for Core Web Vitals

OUT OF SCOPE:
- Fake reviews/ratings, unsupported medical/beauty claims, keyword stuffing, mass-generated thin pages — never in scope
- Paid SEO tools (ask first)

REFERENCE DOCS:
- docs/SEO-AIO-GEO.md
- frontend/AGENT.md (SEO, Accessibility, Performance)
- docs/CATALOGUE-DATA.md (Availability Rules)

SUCCESS CRITERIA:
- Every indexable page has unique title, description, canonical, and Open Graph metadata
- sitemap.xml lists all indexable pages; robots.txt disallows admin/private routes
- JSON-LD validates; Offer emitted only when price and availability are verified
- Accurate PKR currency and Pakistan-specific content
- Required informational and legal pages exist and are owner-reviewed
- Core Web Vitals targets in docs/OBSERVABILITY.md met on key templates (lab measurement recorded)
- Frontend gate passes

OR-E5.Summary: Metadata builders: titles, descriptions, canonical, Open Graph
OR-E5.Description:
Give every page accurate, unique metadata from one set of builders.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- frontend/lib/seo/metadata.ts: buildMetadata({title, description, path, image?, noindex?}) returning Next.js Metadata with canonical (absolute, from SITE_URL setting), Open Graph, and Twitter card
- SITE_URL added to .env.example (public, non-secret) and validated
- Root layout title template '%s | <Store name>'; generateMetadata on products, product detail, categories, search (noindex), referral, content pages
- Product descriptions derived from sourced text, trimmed to ~155 chars without inventing claims

EFFORT: M (4 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Frontend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-E3

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Vitest: canonical absolute and stripped of tracking params; noindex applied to search and paginated filter variants as documented
- Titles unique across a sample of product and category pages

EDGE CASES:
- Filtered/sorted listing URLs: canonical points to the unfiltered listing (or documented policy)
- Missing description: fallback built from name and category, not generic boilerplate repeated site-wide
- SITE_URL missing in production: build fails

Expose crawlable page inventory and crawl rules.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- app/sitemap.ts: homepage, products listing, visible product pages (lastModified from last_synced_at), categories with products, referral and content pages; split into multiple sitemaps if over 50,000 URLs
- app/robots.ts: allow public pages; disallow /admin, /api, /search, /list; reference sitemap URL
- Backend helper endpoint for slugs + timestamps if needed (paginated)

EFFORT: S (3 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Frontend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-036

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Sitemap excludes hidden products, search, list, and admin URLs
- robots.txt content matches policy

EDGE CASES:
- Development fixture data: sitemap and robots disallow-all when APP_ENV is not production (avoid indexing dev/staging)
- Backend unavailable at build: sitemap generation fails loudly rather than publishing an empty sitemap

Add navigational breadcrumbs and structured breadcrumb data.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- components/layout/Breadcrumbs: nav aria-label='Breadcrumb', ordered list, aria-current on last item
- Used on category and product pages from the category ancestor path (OR-019)
- BreadcrumbList JSON-LD emitted alongside
- Related products and category links on PDP support internal linking

EFFORT: S (3 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Frontend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-036

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Vitest: correct order, aria attributes, JSON-LD item positions

EDGE CASES:
- Product in multiple categories: deterministic primary category chosen and documented
- Deeply nested categories: all ancestors shown, no truncation of structured data

OR-E5.Summary: JSON-LD builders: Product, Offer, WebSite, Organization
OR-E5.Description:
Emit valid, truthful structured data.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- frontend/lib/seo/jsonld.ts: productJsonLd(product), offerJsonLd(product) (only if price_pkr present AND availability verified; priceCurrency PKR; availability mapped to schema.org values; url = product page), websiteJsonLd() with SearchAction to /search, organizationJsonLd() describing the independent store (not Oriflame)
- Rendered via a JsonLd component using a script tag with JSON.stringify and safe escaping of '<'
- No aggregateRating or review fields

EFFORT: M (4 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Frontend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-036, OR-021

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Vitest: Offer omitted when price null or availability not_confirmed; present when both verified
- Output passes a structured-data validator (result recorded in todo.md Review)
- Escaping test: product name containing '</script>' cannot break out

EDGE CASES:
- Brand field: 'Oriflame' as product brand is factual; Organization must be the store itself, never claiming to be Oriflame
- Development fixture products: JSON-LD suppressed

OR-E5.Summary: About, contact, privacy, terms, and cookie pages
OR-E5.Description:
Add required informational and legal pages.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- app/about, app/contact, app/privacy, app/terms, app/cookies (Server Components, metadata via OR-036)
- About: who runs the store, independent status, how referral works
- Contact: owner-approved contact method (email/WhatsApp link); if a form is added it uses Zod + React Hook Form, server-side validation, rate limiting, and collects only what is necessary
- Privacy: what is stored (local shopping list in browser, anonymous click counts), no payment/address collection, third parties (Oriflame checkout)
- Cookies: actual cookies/storage used; consent banner only if non-essential cookies are introduced
- Content marked for owner/legal review; footer links to all pages

EFFORT: M (5 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Frontend / Content
DEPENDENCIES: OR-036

TESTING CRITERIA:
- All pages render with unique metadata and are in the sitemap
- Privacy and cookie pages match actual data practices (checklist in todo.md Review)

EDGE CASES:
- No legal template text claiming practices the site does not follow
- Contact details are configuration or owner-approved content, never invented

Publish helpful, original content that answers real visitor questions in a way AI-assisted search can cite.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- FAQ section on /referral (and /faq if warranted): how ordering through Oriflame works, delivery and payment handled by Oriflame, using the consultant code, price accuracy and PKR, availability labels
- 2–4 owner-approved guides (e.g. 'How to order Oriflame products in Pakistan through this store') as app/guides/[slug] pages with metadata
- Content stored as MDX or typed content files; clear headings, concise answers, dates
- FAQPage JSON-LD only where the page genuinely is an FAQ

EFFORT: M (5 hours, plus owner review)
PROJECT AREA: Content / Frontend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-040

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Owner approval recorded for each published piece
- Guides appear in sitemap with unique metadata

EDGE CASES:
- No medical/beauty efficacy claims, no fake testimonials, no mass-generated thin pages
- No promises about delivery times, discounts, or rankings unless confirmed

Meet Core Web Vitals targets on key page templates.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Audit homepage, listing, PDP, category: next/image sizes/priority for LCP image, explicit dimensions (CLS), font loading via next/font
- Minimise client JavaScript: verify only interactive leaves are Client Components; analyse bundle
- Caching/revalidation strategy for catalogue pages documented
- Web Vitals reporting hook (reportWebVitals or equivalent) logging to console in dev and to the chosen analytics endpoint only if approved

EFFORT: M (4 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Frontend / Performance
DEPENDENCIES: OR-E3

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Lab measurements (Lighthouse) for each template recorded in todo.md Review: LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1 on mobile profile
- Bundle size before/after recorded

EDGE CASES:
- Third-party scripts: none added without explicit approval
- Large product images from source: resized via Next.js image optimisation, never served raw

OR-E5.Summary: Documentation sync for SEO, AIO & GEO
OR-E5.Description:
Align documentation with implemented SEO work.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- docs/SEO-AIO-GEO.md: canonical policy, noindex policy, sitemap scope, JSON-LD rules as built
- docs/example-code/jsonld-pattern.ts
- docs/learning/: note on truthful structured data (Offer gating)
- docs/PLAN.md OR-E5 rows complete; todo.md Review with validator and Lighthouse evidence

EFFORT: S (2 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Docs
DEPENDENCIES: OR-036 through OR-042

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Docs match implementation; links resolve

EDGE CASES:
- Docs must not promise ranking outcomes
